_comment_file: Azure Function binding configuration for health endpoint
_comment_security: Health endpoint is public and does not require authentication. authLevel=anonymous allows external monitoring tools to check service health.

bindings._comment_trigger: HTTP GET endpoint for health checks
bindings._comment_authLevel: Set to 'anonymous' to allow unauthenticated access for health monitoring. This is standard practice for health endpoints.
bindings.name: Request
bindings._comment_methods: Only GET allowed. Other HTTP methods are rejected by Azure Functions before reaching code.
bindings._comment_route: Accessible at /api/health (routePrefix defined in host.json). Standard health check endpoint path.

bindings._comment_output: HTTP response binding for returning health status to caller
bindings.name: Response

_usage_notes.purpose: Provides a health check endpoint for monitoring and orchestration systems
_usage_notes.response_format: JSON with status, timestamp, and service information
